Shape its future Home / Academics / Bachelor’s Degrees Bachelor's Degrees The duration of undergraduate education at AUBG is eight semesters. Students may combine up to two majors and two minors at no additional cost. Business Administration You can choose focus on: Accounting Finance Marketing Management Tourism and Hospitality Major Computer Science You can choose focus on: Foundations of Computing Software Development Major Economics Major Economics Minor European Studies Major European Studies Minor Film and Creative Media Major Film and Theater Studies Minor History and Civilizations Major History and Civilizations Minor Information Systems You can choose focus on: e-Commerce Data Science Major Information Systems Minor Journalism and Mass Communication Major Journalism and Mass Communication Minor Literature Major Literature Minor Mathematics Major Mathematics Minor Psychology Major Psychology Minor Physics Major Physics Minor Political Science & International Relations Major Political Science and International Relations Minor Self-Designed Major You can choose focus on: Business Communications and Public Relations Environmental Policy Performing and Visual Arts Political Communication Social Sciences Major Modern Languages and Cultures You can choose focus on: German French Spanish Bulgarian Major Computer Science Minor Entrepreneurship Minor Finance Minor Integrated Marketing Communications Minor Sustainability Studies Minor Creative Writing Minor Fine Arts Minor Modern Languages and Cultures Minor Philosophy Minor Public Policy Minor Southeast European Studies Minor American diploma only American University in Bulgaria Expand your world Copyright 2026.
